policy.graph: Each Graph API version is usable for at least two years; a version stops working two years after the next version is released. Calls to an expired version are defaulted to the next oldest usable version. Unversioned calls use the app's default version (App Dashboard > Settings > Advanced > Upgrade API Version). An app can only call older versions it has already called.
policy.marketing: Marketing API keeps the previous version for at least 90 days after a new one ships. After the grace period, calls to the old version may fail or be upgraded to the next available version; auto-upgrade only happens for endpoints that did not change, so changed endpoints fail. Unversioned calls to Marketing API endpoints fail.
